capture_meta.contract_surprise: There is NO distinct client-side XHR/fetch call that returns the product catalog JSON. The product list is rendered server-side and embedded as a JSON blob inside a <script> tag (window.__sw...chunks) within the full HTML document response for the category page URL. Client-side pagination (?page=N) triggers a full document re-fetch (SSR), not a separate JSON API call. The 'request' captured below is therefore the category page's own document GET request, and the 'response' is the embedded product list extracted from that HTML.

request.note: Standard document navigation request (not XHR/fetch) - Accept: text/html, browser-standard headers, no custom API headers required.
request.cookies_note: Anonymous/guest session cookies (analytics + a JWT-looking session cookie for cart state). Values redacted in this capture for privacy; names listed above.

New Strain from Simply Herb! 

Simply Herb's Lemon Voltage is a Sativa-dominant flower known for delivering energetic, uplifting, and creative effects, often with bright, citrusy lemon aromas and flavors, making it great for daytime focus and inspiration. As a Sativa, it provides a cerebral, energizing buzz that boosts mood and motivation, keeping users functional and happy.

embedded_product_list_page1.name: Jenny Kush
embedded_product_list_page1.description: Named in memory of the late cannabis activist Jenny Monson, this perfectly balanced hybrid was first bred for a foundation that helped support Monson’s children. Jenny Kush combines elevating and mentally stimulating effects with a subtle relaxation, allowing it to be enjoyed all throughout the day. A fresh, sharp aroma announces the fruity and herbal notes that define this sought-after strain.

embedded_product_list_page1.description: Butterstuff is a colorful and potent flower that has an aroma and taste that can be described as very loud with hints of nut, fuel, garlic and cream. Butterstuff greets you with a relaxing, sedative and spacey high that is fantastic for a relaxing night in or just trying to wind down for the evening.

embedded_product_list_page1.name: Blockberry
embedded_product_list_page1.description:
Blockberry is a true hybrid that brings balance in both structure and effect. Bred from Black Cherry Punch and Tropicana Cookies, this strain delivers dense olive green buds streaked with purple and coated in frosty trichomes. Best suited for those who want a potent well rounded experience. 
The aroma blends earthy berries, citrus, and a touch of funk, thanks to a terpene profile led by Myrcene, Caryophyllene, and Limonene. 

Effects come on smooth. Expect an uplifting euphoric headspace paired with calm focus and creativity. Whether you are heading out for a hike or sinking into a new project, Blockberry keeps your mood high and your mind grounded.   Top Terpenes: Myrcene, Caryophyllene, Limonene

Flavor: Berries, citrus, sweet funk
Lineage: Black Cherry Punch x Tropicana Cookies 

Best For: Daytime vibes, creative focus, feel good energy

embedded_product_list_page1.name: Singapore Sling
embedded_product_list_page1.description:
Fruity aromas of citrus and a sweetness of sugar are most obvious when you first pop open the jar. No matter how you enjoy the flower, the flavors stay as prevalent as the smells. The obvious citric smell turns into a medley of fruit flavors, with lemon, raspberry and black cherry all swirling together. A sweet, smoky flavor sticks around on the palate long after every exhale. With its family tree having firm roots in equatorial strains (Tiki Cookies and Creamsicle), Singapore Sling has been a favorite for creativity and uplifted moods.

Lineage: Tiki Cookies X Creamsicle
Flavors: Muddled Fruit, Orange Zest, Smoky Sugar
Aromas: Fresh Lemons, Floral, Sweetener
Top Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene
Dominance: Sativa

embedded_product_list_page1.name: Banana Daddy
embedded_product_list_page1.description:

Expect an energetic euphoric lift that softens into a calm body forward buzz. Ideal for mornings with momentum or evenings on cruise control.

embedded_product_list_page1.name: Mac 1
embedded_product_list_page1.description:
Mac 1 is a hybrid strain created from Alien Cookies F2 and Miracle 15. 

It delivers a smooth potent experience that pairs well with a variety of moods and settings. The buds are dense and frosty, shimmering with trichomes and offering a creamy diesel kick on the inhale. A citrus forward aroma comes from the dominant terpene Limonene, while Terpinolene and Pinene add earthy and herbal undertones. The flavor is bold and layered, with a funky citrus finish that lingers.

 This strain offers a balanced high that uplifts the mood and relaxes the body. Whether you are diving into a creative project, catching up with friends, or just unwinding with your favorite show, Mac 1 fits right in.

Top Terpenes: Limonene, Terpinolene, Pinene
